main.description: Get a cart that pays the authenticated user — a cart whose items target this user. Look up by cart URI, by a contained item record URI, or by a contained subscription record URI. One of `uri`, `itemUri`, or `subscriptionUri` is required.

uri.description: AT-URI of the cart record. Takes precedence over itemUri and subscriptionUri.

itemUri.description: AT-URI of an item record received by the authed user. Returns the cart that contains this item. Ignored if uri is provided.

subscriptionUri.description: AT-URI of a subscription record received by the authed user. Returns the cart that contains this subscription. Ignored if uri or itemUri is provided.

items.description: Resolved item records in this cart that target the authed user

subscriptions.description: Resolved subscription records in this cart that target the authed user
